translation.title: Guaiazulene Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for eczema, burns, and erosions and ulcers caused by other conditions.
translation.usage: Apply to the affected area several times a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it. Before using it, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are or have been hypersensitive to propylene glycol. Do not use it in the eyes. Skin irritation symptoms such as a feeling of heat, itching or a stinging sensation may occur; if they do, stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
